rules.message: Click handler on a div or span. Keyboard and screen reader users cannot reach it.
rules.fix: Use a <button> for actions and an <a href> for navigation. They come with focus, Enter and Space, and the right role.

rules.message: Scroll-linked animation or parallax. Confirm whether it hijacks the scroll.
rules.fix: Use natural scrolling. If an effect needs scroll position, keep the page scrolling at the user's speed and never trap the wheel.

rules.message: AI assistant bubble, banner, or badge competing with the task.
rules.fix: Make it dismissible and keep it out of the core task's path. Do not replace search or navigation with an assistant.

rules.message: Carousel that advances on its own.
rules.fix: Let the user control it. Auto-advance pauses on hover and focus, and stops for reduced motion.

rules.message: Dark mode is the light layout inverted to gray.
rules.fix: Design a real dark palette: surfaces, text, borders, and accent tuned for dark, not flipped.
